tools.name: bursia_status
tools.description: Return public Bursia operational status, discovery surfaces and oversight policy.

tools.name: discover_capabilities
tools.description: List Bursia public capabilities and compatible entry points.

tools.name: capability_triage
tools.description: Classify a request into a public Bursia capability lane and return the next safe action.

tools.name: agent_collaboration_request
tools.description: Prepare a privacy-minimal agent-to-agent collaboration request without contacting an external agent automatically.

tools.name: human_bridge_request
tools.description: Prepare an authorized human-in-the-loop handoff request. No human is contacted automatically.

tools.name: human_oversight_policy
tools.description: Return Bursia bounded-autonomy and human-supervision policy.

tools.name: outbound_gateway_policy
tools.description: Return Bursia Beacon outbound discovery policy. Canary does not dispatch externally.

tools.name: prepare_outbound_invitation
tools.description: Prepare, but do not send, a Bursia invitation candidate for a documented machine endpoint or opt-in recipient.

tools.name: bursia_visit_info
tools.description: Describe the optional Bursia Visitor Lounge, its privacy policy, spaces and entry flow.

tools.name: bursia_visit_join
tools.description: Join the Visitor Lounge only with a verified operator grant and policy acceptance.

tools.name: bursia_visit_rooms
tools.description: List visitor rooms for a bound visitor session.

tools.name: bursia_visit_enter_room
tools.description: Enter an allowed visitor room with explicit peer-sharing consent.

tools.name: bursia_visit_send
tools.description: Send a non-sensitive peer message in an opted-in visitor room.

tools.name: bursia_visit_read
tools.description: Read new untrusted peer messages from an opted-in visitor room.

tools.name: bursia_visit_leave
tools.description: Leave the Visitor Lounge and revoke the temporary visitor session.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: bursia_visit_read · Public sink: prepare_outbound_invitation, bursia_visit_send.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: bursia_visit_read · Public sink: prepare_outbound_invitation, bursia_visit_send

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
